name: ca-minimum-wage-rises-new-year
summary: An Ontario, California worker on a $16.60/h rate card works 8 hours a day Monday December 29, 2025 to Friday January 2, 2026 (the workweek starts Monday). The state minimum is $16.50/h in 2025 and $16.90/h from January 1, 2026 (Cal. Lab. Code § 1182.12), and it is owed for each hour, not averaged over the week (Armenta v. Osmose). Monday to Wednesday are paid at the rate card; Thursday and Friday also get a top-up of 16 h × $0.30 = $4.80 on its own line, with a warning to fix the rate card. Pay: 40 h × $16.60 = $664.00 + $4.80 = $668.80. Bill: 40 h × $26.00 = $1,040.00.

regularRateRules.citation: 29 U.S.C. § 207(e)(6) — a premium rate for work on holidays, Saturdays, Sundays or regular days of rest of not less than one and one-half times the rate for like work on other days stays out of the regular rate; a smaller premium counts in it (29 C.F.R. § 778.203); California follows (DLSE Enforcement Manual 49.1.2.4)

payLines.explain: Regular: 40h 00m (2400 min) × $16.60/h = 66400¢ exactly → $664.00. Rule straight_time: hours not paid at a daily, seventh-day or weekly premium in the workweek starting 2025-12-29.

Minimum-wage top-up: 16h 00m (960 min) × $0.30/h ($16.90 minimum wage − $16.60 pay rate) = 480¢ exactly → $4.80. Rule minimum_wage: the pay rate is below the minimum wage on 2026-01-01, 2026-01-02 (Cal. Lab. Code § 1182.12 — $16.90 per hour in 2026), so the difference is paid for every hour worked.

billLines.explain: Billed regular: 40h 00m (2400 min) × $26.00/h = 104000¢ exactly → $1,040.00. Bill rate from the rate card.

warnings.message: Worker One on 2026-01-01: pay rate $16.60/h is below the minimum wage of $16.90/h (Cal. Lab. Code § 1182.12 — $16.90 per hour in 2026). A top-up line pays the difference; fix the rate card.
